In a patient with a normal healthy mouth, you would expect the mucosa covering the alveolar process supporting the mandibular teeth to be
Option A: light pink in colour on both sides of the mucogingigival junction.
Option B: light pink below the mucogingival junction and red above it.
Option C: red below the mucogingival junction and light pink above it.
Option D: red on both sides of the mucogingival junction.
